# PlanBot - AI-Powered Daily Planner

> PlanBot is an AI-powered daily planner for Android that creates personalized daily schedules using advanced AI. Built by PlannextTech for students (JEE, NEET, UPSC), professionals, athletes, and entrepreneurs. Free tier available with daily AI plans; paid tiers unlock more powerful AI models, up to 100 plans history, weekly AI reports, and multi-goal tracking.

PlanBot transforms static to-do lists into dynamic, AI-generated schedules. By leveraging multiple AI model tiers (Basic, Standard, Advanced, Premium), the app generates optimized daily plans from natural language goal descriptions. Gamification features include daily streaks, XP points, level progression, and consistency tracking. Elite and God tier users receive personalized weekly AI performance reports.

Key facts:
- Platform: Android only (Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cpm.planbot)
- Pricing: Free / Pro ₹99/mo / Elite ₹129/mo / God ₹249/mo (UPI and credit card support)
- Developer: PlannextTech, founded by Naitik Baldaniya
- Country: India (Global availability)
- Target users: Students (competitive exams), professionals, athletes, entrepreneurs
